title: Probing Two Dark Dimensions through Primordial Black Holes, Gravitational Waves, and Colliders
summary: We study primordial-black-hole (PBH) dark matter in the two-dark-dimensions (2DD) framework, a six-dimensional brane-world scenario with two compact extra dimensions and a fundamental gravity scale of order $10\,\mathrm{TeV}$. We calculate the evolution of higher-dimensional PBHs including the recently proposed quantum-gravitational memory-burden effect. For a memory exponent $p=2$, the evaporation rate is strongly suppressed, allowing PBHs with initial masses as small as $\sim10^{-3}\,\mathrm{g}$ to survive until the present epoch. Consequently, PBHs can account for the observed dark matter…
